## The heuristic

**An out-of-profile win is evidence about the profile, not permission to widen it.
**


_Why:_ One win is noise and the person who closed it has every incentive to read it as a trend. A repeated cluster of unexpected wins is a candidate segment, and a candidate segment gets validated on retention like any other — it does not get appended to the existing profile, because appending is how a classifier is turned into a list of everyone.
